title: HR support
notice_text:
This standard included a transition arrangement for the minimum off‑the‑job training requirement for learners starting between 1 August and 31 December 2025.
Overview of the role
Handling day to day queries and providing human resources advice ranging from recruitment through to retirement.
version_log: The funding band for this standard has been reviewed as part of the apprenticeship funding band review. The new funding band is £4500
